requirements.name: Dynamic portfolio
requirements.acceptance: Every cycle loads enabled projects from razzo/projects.json without hard-coded project lists.

requirements.name: Live canonical state
requirements.acceptance: Integration HEAD, open objective PRs, candidate SHA and checks are read live from GitHub; snapshots never authorize execution alone.

requirements.name: Delivery Objective identity
requirements.acceptance: One deterministic fingerprint is stable across reruns and excludes run IDs.

requirements.name: Single canonical branch and PR
requirements.acceptance: One objective fingerprint maps to one canonical branch and at most one open PR.

requirements.name: Dynamic decomposition
requirements.acceptance: Planner derives a DAG from the exact repository and objective without embedding solution code in the control plane.

requirements.name: Bounded real parallelism
requirements.acceptance: At most five builders run concurrently until higher capacity is measured; every builder owns one independent shred contract.

requirements.name: Collision-safe leases
requirements.acceptance: No two active shreds may share a collision domain or objective responsibility; leases survive workflow retries.

requirements.name: Repository-local execution contract
requirements.acceptance: Each product declares setup, unit, candidate, functional test and merge policy locally.

requirements.name: Builder isolation
requirements.acceptance: Builders modify only allowed surfaces, create non-empty commits, never open product PRs and never receive prewritten solution code.

requirements.name: Objective assembly
requirements.acceptance: Verified shred commits are composed into the canonical objective branch with deterministic conflict handling.

requirements.name: Product CI exact-head
requirements.acceptance: Required product checks run on and report success for the exact candidate SHA of the PR.

requirements.name: Independent functional QA
requirements.acceptance: The Collaudatore tests acceptance criteria on the same candidate SHA and can emit PASS, FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE.

requirements.name: Expected-head protection
requirements.acceptance: Merge is forbidden when PR head, tested candidate, CI head or QA head differ.

requirements.name: Truthful evidence
requirements.acceptance: Append-only events reference real GitHub objects and never classify control-plane activity as product progress.

requirements.name: Human gates are action-scoped
requirements.acceptance: Only sensitive actions are blocked; unrelated safe work remains runnable.

requirements.name: Self-replan
requirements.acceptance: After verified merge the system reassesses the product and creates or selects the next useful objective without operator task enumeration.

requirements.name: Event-driven continuation
requirements.acceptance: Primary progress resumes from GitHub events; scheduled jobs act only as watchdog and recovery.

requirements.name: Multi-project fairness
requirements.acceptance: Enabled projects receive bounded fair capacity while preserving product priority and backpressure.

requirements.name: Private-source hygiene
requirements.acceptance: Private checkouts, tokens and generated source are purged; public control-plane artifacts contain no private source or secrets.

requirements.name: Operational proof
requirements.acceptance: A real non-hard-coded objective completes decomposition, multi-builder delivery, one PR, exact-head CI, QA, merge, zero duplicates and self-replan.
